description: Catalogo euromediterraneo dello tsunami (EMTC), versione 2.0 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by tsunamiarchive.ingv.it. The Catalogue of Euro-Mediterranean Tsunamis (EMTC2.0), realized in ArcGis online, contains 293 tsunamis and is the updated version of EMTC published in 2014. The Italian section of the database was revised in order to implement the new database of tsunami effects along the Italian coasts (ITED). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Euro-Mediterranean Tsunami Catalogue (EMTC), version 2.0" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include tsunami intensity, historical tsunamis, open data, euro-mediterreanean region, tsunamis. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
